verdict.rationale: Pika's own docs describe operating it through natural language. It offers 40+ creative apps 'without leaving your conversation'. A first-party Pika MCP connects it to ChatGPT, Claude and other agents. Many tools are driven by text descriptions, such as describing an edit, adding a prompt to guide motion, or turning a premise into a film. However, the evidence is marketing-level only, and it does not show that end-to-end operation (beyond generation prompts) is controllable by natural-language commands. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the conversational/agent command interface, evidence that non-generation operations (account, project management) work via natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
